Compare colony measurements while accounting for plates

Source: R/stats.R
compare_melanization.Rd

Preserves the MycoHalo argument names. For MI with set_id metadata this delegates to assess_experiment() so each treatment uses its own control. For other outcomes, or a legacy single-set table, it fits the original plate-aware comparison with lmerTest Satterthwaite inference instead of the old ad hoc degrees of freedom. Multi-set assessment of MI should use assess_experiment() directly. Never compare shared-denominator MC rows as independent observations.

Usage

compare_melanization(
  colonies,
  response = "MI_mean",
  group = "treatment",
  plate = "plate_id",
  reference = NULL,
  method = c("auto", "mixed", "plate_means"),
  by = NULL,
  control = NULL,
  require_qc = FALSE
)

Arguments

colonies

Colony table.

response

Numeric response column, default MI_mean.

group

Treatment column.

plate

Plate ID column.

reference

Reference treatment; defaults to control if available.

method

auto, mixed, or plate_means. auto chooses mixed with at least three plates per group, otherwise an explicit plate-mean model.

by

Extra control-matching columns for matched MI assessment.

control

Optional control label, alias of reference for matched MI.

require_qc

Require explicit image QC approval for matched MI analysis. Default FALSE warns on unconfirmed recorded QC.

Value

A list with model, coefficients, descriptives and status; matched MI results also contain the complete assessment and matched_coefficients.
